about: OCTOPATH TRAVELER, the RPG that sold over 3 million copies worldwide (as of September 2022), is now available on PS4 and PS5! Retro pixel graphics and modern 3DCG come together to create an enchanting HD-2D world where you can embark on an adventure all your own!
In the faraway land of Orsterra, eight travelers venture forth.
Step into their shoes and explore the realm as you see fit.
Eight brave souls, each with a unique talent.
Eight lands, eight stories to be told.
So tell me, friend, what path will you tread?
Set forth on a journey all your own.
1. Journey through a unique and enchanting world of HD-2D graphics—a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG.
2. Classic command-based clashes combine with a unique Break & Boost system for more strategic battles.
3. Begin your adventure as one of eight travelers, each with their own origins, motivations, and unique skills. Where will you go? Who will you share the road with? Every choice is yours to make.
summary: OCTOPATH TRAVELER, the RPG that sold over 3 million copies worldwide (as of September 2022), is now available on PS4 and PS5!
